info.title: Himalayas Remote Jobs API
info.description:
Himalayas (https://himalayas.app) is the leading remote job board. This is its free, public REST API — no authentication required. Himalayas exposes two JSON endpoints: `/jobs/api` for browsing the full remote jobs feed with pagination, and `/jobs/api/search` for filtered job search by keyword, country, worldwide availability, seniority, employment type, company slug, timezone, sort order, and page. Himalayas aggregates thousands of verified remote positions from top companies worldwide, with new jobs added daily. Data is updated every 24 hours. Himalayas also offers an MCP Server (https://himalayas.app/mcp) with real-time tools for job posting, talent search, and candidate messaging — the recommended way for AI agents to interact with the remote job market.

**2026-06-08:** Added `salaryPeriod` (`hourly`, `weekly`, `fortnightly`, `monthly`, `annual`, default `annual`). `minSalary` and `maxSalary` are now in the stated period, not normalized to annual. Responses always include `salaryPeriod`; legacy listings without an explicit period report `annual`.

tags.name: Jobs
tags.description: Remote job listings from Himalayas. Use the browse endpoint to page through the full feed, or the search endpoint to filter by keyword, country, seniority, employment type, company slug, timezone, and sort order.

get.summary: Browse the full Himalayas remote jobs feed
get.description: Returns the full unfiltered remote jobs feed from Himalayas (https://himalayas.app) with offset/limit pagination. Use this endpoint when you want to page through all current jobs, backfill a job board, or sync the entire feed into your own system. If you want filtered search results instead, use `GET /jobs/api/search`.

externalDocs.description: Browse endpoint documentation with code examples

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of jobs per page. Maximum and default is 20. Use 20 for fastest pagination.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of jobs to skip. Start at 0, then increment by limit (e.g., 0, 20, 40, 60) to page through results. Use totalCount from the response to know when to stop.

200.description: Successful response with remote job listings from Himalayas

400.description: Invalid query parameters. Check that limit is between 1-20 and offset is a non-negative integer.

example.error: Invalid parameters. limit must be 1-20, offset must be >= 0.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded. Wait 60 seconds before retrying.

example.error: Rate limit exceeded. Wait 60 seconds before retrying.

get.summary: Search Himalayas remote jobs with filters
get.description: Returns filtered remote job results in the same JSON shape as `GET /jobs/api`. Use this endpoint when you want to search by keyword, country, worldwide availability, seniority, employment type, company slug, timezone, sort order, or page without paging through the full feed locally.

externalDocs.description: Search endpoint documentation with filter examples

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country filter. Supports ISO alpha-2, common country names, slugs, and common abbreviations.

parameters.name: exclude_worldwide
parameters.description: Exclude worldwide matches when a country filter is present.

parameters.name: seniority
parameters.description: Comma-separated seniority filters. Valid values are Entry-level, Mid-level, Senior, Manager, Director, and Executive.

parameters.name: employment_type
parameters.description: Comma-separated employment type filters. Valid values are Full Time, Part Time, Contractor, Temporary, Intern, Volunteer, and Other.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Canonical company slug. Supports comma-separated values.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: Timezone filter. Supports numeric UTC offsets and variants like `UTC-5` or `UTC+05:30`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order for results. 'relevant' ranks by best match to the query and filters (default). 'recent' returns newest jobs first. 'salaryAsc' returns lowest salary first. 'salaryDesc' returns highest salary first. 'nameAToZ' sorts by company name A to Z. 'nameZToA' sorts by company name Z to A. 'jobs' sorts by companies with the most open roles first.

200.description: Successful filtered response with remote job listings from Himalayas

400.description: Invalid explicit filter value, such as an unrecognized country or timezone.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded. Wait 60 seconds before retrying.

example.error: Rate limit exceeded. Wait 60 seconds before retrying.

comments.description: Release notes or changelog for the Himalayas API
comments.example: 13/03/2026: The API has been updated to include the companySlug field in the response.

updatedAt.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the data was last updated

offset.description: The offset used in this request

limit.description: The limit used in this request

totalCount.description: Total number of matching jobs across all pages. For the browse endpoint this is the total count of all active remote jobs; for the search endpoint this is the count of jobs matching the active filters. Use Math.ceil(totalCount / limit) to calculate total pages.

excerpt.description: Short summary of the job (first few sentences of the description)
excerpt.example: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our remote team...

companySlug.description: Canonical company slug for filtering and stable lookups

companyLogo.description: URL of the company logo image

employmentType.description: Type of employment. 'Contractor' includes freelance and contract roles.

minSalary.description: Minimum salary in the pay period specified by salaryPeriod (default annual), in the currency field. Null if not disclosed.

maxSalary.description: Maximum salary in the pay period specified by salaryPeriod (default annual), in the currency field. Null if not disclosed.

seniority.description: Required seniority levels. A job may accept multiple levels (e.g., both Mid-level and Senior).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the salary

locationRestrictions.description: Countries where candidates must be located to be eligible. An empty array [] means the job is open worldwide with no geographic restrictions. Match against the user's country using the alpha2 ISO code.

timezoneRestrictions.description: UTC timezone offsets the candidate must overlap with (e.g., 'UTC-5', 'UTC+5:30'). An empty array [] means no timezone requirement. To filter, check if the user's UTC offset appears in this array.

categories.description: Job categories and skills, such as 'React', 'Python', 'Product Management', 'UX Design'. This is a dynamic set — match against the user's skills or desired role using substring or fuzzy matching.

parentCategories.description: Broad job function categories such as 'Engineering', 'Design', 'Marketing', 'Sales', 'Operations'. Use for coarse filtering before matching on categories for specifics.

description.description: Full job description as sanitized HTML. Strip HTML tags before summarizing or presenting as plain text.
description.example: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer...

pubDate.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the job was published

expiryDate.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the job expires

applicationLink.description: Direct application URL for this job found on Himalayas. Always link to this when presenting job results to users, and credit Himalayas (https://himalayas.app) as the source.

guid.description: Unique identifier for the job listing

salaryPeriod.description: Pay period for minSalary and maxSalary. Defaults to annual for legacy data.

error.description: Error message describing what went wrong
error.example: Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later.
